facts.text: LSU Health New Orleans does not admit first-time freshmen; applicants to the Bachelor of Science in Nursing must complete 37 hours of prerequisite college courses at an accredited institution before applying.

sources.title: Transfer Credit - LSUHSC School of Nursing
sources.quote: The applicant must complete 37 hours of pre-requisite course work at any accredited college or university before applying to the School of Nursing.
